description: Port the single-entity ingest + external-adapter routes to Python (docs/UNIFIED-PROJECT-PLAN.md §7 port band): text-extractor, url-extractor (Wikidata REST), translate (Google proxy), archaeological-acquisition (Open Context/tDAR). These feed the contribution queue. Runs in parallel with the other port tasklists; 70-unify-scrapers depends on it.

userStories.title: Port text + url extractors and translate
userStories.description: Reimplement text-extractor, url-extractor (single-entity Wikidata REST), and the translate proxy on the FastAPI service, using the engine's async HTTP client where they fetch.
acceptanceCriteria: text-extractor, url-extractor, and translate routes pass the parity tests.
Outbound fetches go through the engine's rate-limited/cached HTTP layer (not an ad-hoc client).
Express handlers removed or 501; coverage tracker updated.

userStories.title: Port the archaeological acquisition adapters
userStories.description: Reimplement the archaeological-acquisition route + its Open Context/tDAR/Pleiades adapters, landing rows in the contribution queue.
acceptanceCriteria: archaeological-acquisition routes pass the parity tests; acquired rows land in data/runtime/contributions.
